+---
+assignees:

+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8980'
+title: Test a tiny Qwen3.5 hybrid entry through ExecutorPromptCacheFile into newCache templates, with warm and cold equivalence
+---
+## What
+
+Path gap, not a line gap. The lines are covered by other tests, but no unit test sends a real Qwen cache shape through the executor file.
+
+Files and measured coverage:
+- `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/ExecutorPromptCacheFile.swift` `prepare(_:key:)` 86-99 and `read(from:key:templates:)` 134-158: 100%. The only fixtures are `KVCacheSimple`, an unwrapped `RotatingKVCache` and a `MambaCache` with ramp values, and a model state under the test key `test.ropeDeltas` (`Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/ExecutorPromptCacheFileTests.swift:139-170`).
+- `Libraries/MLXVLM/Models/Qwen35.swift` `Qwen35.newCache(parameters:)` 1108-1110: 3/3; `Qwen35.prepare(_:cache:state:prefill:)` 1231-1279: 49/49.
+- `Libraries/MLXVLM/Models/Qwen3VL.swift` `Qwen3VL.prepare(_:cache:state:prefill:)` 1812-1854: 43/43.
+
+The Qwen tests that use a file (`Tests/MLXLMTests/Qwen35ContinuationTests.swift:178-268`, `Tests/MLXLMTests/Qwen3VLContinuationTests.swift:294-338`) use `savePromptCache` and `loadPromptCacheSnapshot(url:)`, which builds new caches from the class names. The executor uses `loadPromptCacheSnapshot(url:into:)` with `model.newCache(parameters:)` templates, the offset check of `ExecutorPromptCacheFile.read` and the token ledgers. No test runs a Qwen3.5 hybrid (`MambaCache` + `KVCacheSimple`) or a Qwen3-VL cache through that path.
+
+What to test:
+- Make the tiny Qwen3.5 model of `Qwen35ContinuationTests.makeTinyModel()` (4 layers, `full_attention_interval` 2) and the tiny Qwen3-VL model of `Qwen3VLContinuationTests`.
+- Prefill a text prompt into `model.newCache(parameters: nil)`. Make an `ExecutorPromptCacheEntry` with the caches, the ledger, a render ledger and the `LMOutput.State` of the prefill.
+- `ExecutorPromptCacheFile.prepare`, `write`, then `read(from:key:templates: model.newCache(parameters: nil))`.
+- Expect: the restored classes are the classes of `newCache` (the restore writes into the templates), every offset equals the ledger length, `tokens` and `renderTokens` are equal, and `state?[qwen35.ropeDeltas]` (or `qwen35vl.ropeDeltas`) equals the saved array.
+- Continue with the next text tokens on the restored entry and on the live caches. The last logits must agree within 1e-6. The logits must also agree within 1e-3 with a cold prefill of the whole prompt.
+- Negative control: read the file, drop the state, and expect `ContinuationStateError.missingState` from `prepare`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A test proves the Qwen3.5 hybrid round trip through `ExecutorPromptCacheFile` with `newCache` templates, with the logits checks above.
+- [ ] A test proves the same for the Qwen3-VL model.
+- [ ] Each test checks the model state key by its real name, not a test key.
+- [ ] The negative control throws `ContinuationStateError.missingState`.
+- [ ] All five unit bundles pass.
+
+## Tests
+
+Test file: `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/ExecutorPromptCacheQwenFileTests.swift` (new file; the bundle links MLXLLM and the MLXVLM trampoline, see `Package.swift:307-330`).
+
+Run:
+
+```sh
+swift build --build-tests
+xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXFoundationModelsTests.xctest
+```
+
+## Workflow
+
+- Use `/tdd` #coverage-gap #prompt-cache
\ No newline at end of file

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m3cr2fj6y7nf34bpzggz3vve
+  text: |-
+    Discovery: the cold check of 1e-3 does not hold in the MLXFoundationModelsTests process, and the cause is not in the library path under test.
+
+    Measured with the same tiny Qwen3.5 (same weights, weight sum 836.8966), 40 prompt tokens and 8 continuation tokens:
+    - MLXLMTests process: warm continuation against cold prefill = 1.3e-6.
+    - MLXFoundationModelsTests process: warm against cold = 3.09e-3 (Qwen3.5) and 3.19e-3 (Qwen3-VL). The decode path (one token for each step, the offset-correct control) against cold = 3.0e-3 also. Restored against live = below 1e-6, thus the file path is exact.
+    - A plain float32 `matmul` of the same two arrays gives 502.14685 in MLXLMTests and 501.8337 in MLXFoundationModelsTests. With `MLX_ENABLE_TF32=0` the MLXFoundationModelsTests process gives 502.14685 and 1.3e-6 again.
+    - Cause: `metal::is_nax_available()` is true in the MLXFoundationModelsTests process only, and MLX then multiplies float32 matrices in TF32 (`matmul.cpp:366`, `MLX_ENABLE_TF32` on by default). Both bundles have the same `default.metallib` (same SHA-1).
+
+    Decision: the cold bound is the rule of `ContinuationAssertions.assertWarmTextContinuation` in MLXLMTests: `max(10 * noiseFloor, 1e-3)`, with the noise floor from the decode path. The restored-against-live bound stays at 1e-6. The follow-up task records why NAX is on in one bundle only.
+
+    Other notes: a `#expect((a as AnyObject) === (b as AnyObject))` inside the macro crashes the Swift compiler (SIL verifier), thus the test compares `ObjectIdentifier` lists. `import MLXLLM` in the same file makes `Qwen35Configuration` ambiguous, thus the file imports MLXVLM only.
